x-fc-pending.title: Pending of the spec
x-fc-pending.description: Routes, fields, schemas, responses and events that the production API already has but the spec/funnelchat.json snapshot (13-10) does not include yet. The generator (`composer generate`, scripts/generate.php) adds them to the spec before generating the resources and types, only while the snapshot lacks them: when a new snapshot includes them, generation uses the snapshot's version and reports which entries in this file can be deleted. The entries of a source marked NOT IN PRODUCTION YET come from a contract, ahead of the code.

rules.paths: An operation (method + route) is added only if the snapshot does not have it.
rules.operationPatches: A patch adds properties to the body of a snapshot operation only while that operation meets the `while` condition.
rules.webhooks: An event is added if the snapshot does not have it, or replaces the snapshot's while it meets the `x-fc-replace-while` condition.
rules.responsePatches: A patch replaces the responses of a snapshot operation (all the 2xx ones, and any others it includes by code) only while that operation meets the `while` condition.
rules.webhookPatches: A patch adds properties to the `data` of a snapshot event only while the event does not include them (neither in its schema nor in its example).
rules.components.schemas: The schemas in this layer start with `Pending` so they do not clash with the snapshot's.
rules.schemaPatches: A patch adds properties to a snapshot schema only while the schema does not include them.
rules.parameterPatches: A patch adds query parameters to a snapshot operation only while that operation does not declare them.

sources.accounts-number-onboarding: NOT IN PRODUCTION YET. Creating and connecting numbers by API, from the contract `1022-alta-de-numeros.md` v0.1 (23-10: sections A1 and A3, and its "Enmienda v0.1", which describes accounts `feat/alta-de-numeros-api` @ 52d49b319 as the coordinator read it, plus what part 2, still in progress, adds) of funnelchat-dev-platform @ 8c68067 (docs/initiatives/api-abierta/contratos), not from accounts' code or OpenAPI, which will be the final source. The new fields of the events are optional in the types: production does not send them until the deploy. `POST /api/v1/devices`, `GET /api/v1/devices/{device}/qr`, the `external_reference` filter of `GET /api/v1/devices`, the `connect-links` routes, the `Idempotency-Key` header of both creates, `external_reference` and `connection` on the number, and the events `device.connected` (with `connection`, `external_reference` and `connect_link_id`), `device.disconnected` (with `reason`), `device.deleted` and `device.health_changed`. Revise every entry with this source against accounts' OpenAPI before publishing.

PendingClientReference.description: Your reference to correlate the send with the history and with `message.status_changed`: 1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. It is neither unique nor authenticated; do not put personal data in it.

campaign_ids.description: Delivers only the events of these campaigns. An event without a campaign does not pass the filter.

PendingWebhookSubscription.description: A unified webhook subscription. It never includes the secret.

id.description: Subscription ID. Save it when you create the subscription: it is what identifies yours.

secret.description: The full secret for verifying the signature. It is shown only once: save it.

url.description: `https`, public, and without a username or password.

events.description: Types from the catalog (`GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`). The API key needs the `{area}:read` permission for each type's area.

PendingWebhookSubscriptionDelivery.description: A delivery attempt. Attempts for the same event share `event_id`.

PendingWebhookSubscriptionTestResult.description: Result of the test delivery (`webhook.test`). It responds 200 even if your server fails: check `succeeded`.

PendingPublicMessage.description: A message as an API key sees it: always these ten fields.

id.description: The message ID in the contact's history: the same `message_id` as in `message.status_changed`.

status.description: A newly accepted send is `queued`; queued does not mean sent. `null` on a received message, on a note, or when it is unknown.

PendingForwardResult.description: A forward destination, in the requested order.

message.description: `null` if nothing was recorded for that destination.

PendingDeviceCapabilities.description: What the number can do through the API. Pending of the spec (accounts v1.4.24).

groups.description: All `false` on an official number without the groups beta or in coexistence.

add_participants.description: `direct` on a QR number, `invite` on an official number.

statuses.description: The delivery statuses the number reports.

PendingMessageError.description: Why it failed. If Funnelchat decided it, `code` is `null`, `title` is a text and `reason` gives the reason; if WhatsApp reported it, `code` and `title` are Meta's and `reason` is `null`.

PendingForm.description: A version of a WhatsApp form. `id` is the version's ID; `family_id` is the form's.

updated_at.description: Send it as `expected_updated_at` when you save, so you do not overwrite another change.

PendingExternalReference.description: Your own reference for the number (for example, your customer's ID). Free text, it can repeat. It comes back in the number, in the list filter and in every `device.*` event.

PendingConnectionType.description: How the number is connected: `qr` (WhatsApp Web session, not official), `coexistence` (WhatsApp Cloud API alongside the WhatsApp Business app), `dedicated` (WhatsApp Cloud API only), or `null` when it cannot be told.

connection.description: Only `qr` for now: an official number is created with a connect link.

same_number_as.description: The `id` of an official number in coexistence: adds the QR method to that same phone number without using quota.

qr_code.description: A PNG image as a data URI (`data:image/png;base64,…`), or `null` once the number is connected.

expires_in.description: Seconds before asking for the QR again: 20 with a QR, 3 while the session starts, 0 once connected.

PendingConnectLinkErrorCode.description: Why the link did not complete, or `null`.

type.description: `meta`: WhatsApp Cloud API with Meta's Embedded Signup. `qr`: a page that shows the QR and renews it.

allowed_connection_types.description: Required when `type` is `meta`, forbidden when it is `qr`. With both, your customer chooses on the page.

provision_us_number.description: Only `meta` (forbidden with `qr`): offers a US number from the pool (3 per account, 1 on trial accounts, held 15 minutes).

device_id.description: Reconnects this existing number instead of creating one: it uses no new quota. `type` must match the number's method. It revokes the previous reconnect links of that number.

same_number_as.description: Only `qr`, and not with `device_id`: adds QR to a number in coexistence.

return_url.description: `https` only. When the page ends it redirects to `return_url?connect_link_id=<id>&status=<completed|failed>&device_id=<id?>&error_code=<code?>`, nothing else.

PendingConnectLink.description: A single-use link where your customer creates or reconnects a number, without a Funnelchat session.

url.description: `https://<public host>/connect/<token>`. Only in the answer of the create: the token is not stored, so the link cannot be read again.

device_id.description: The number to reconnect, or the one it created once `completed`; `null` otherwise.

PendingConnectLinkId.description: The connect link that connected this number the last time, or `null`.

post.description:
Creates a number of the account, not connected yet: then ask for its QR with `GET /api/v1/devices/{device}/qr`, or send your customer a connect link (`POST /api/v1/connect-links`). An official (WhatsApp Cloud) number is created only with a connect link. It uses the plan's quota, counted by phone number, with the same refusals and the same trial-account rule as the panel; the provider is the one the system assigns.

`Idempotency-Key` (optional, up to 255 characters, kept 24 hours per account): the same key with the same body answers the same number without creating another (only successful answers are replayed, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a refusal is evaluated again); with a different body, `422 idempotency_key_mismatch`; while the first one runs, `409 operation_in_progress`.

**Pending of the spec** (contract 1022-alta-de-numeros, not in production yet).

201.description: The number, with `connected: false`, `connection: "qr"` and its `external_reference`.

403.description: `numbers_not_included` (the plan includes no numbers), `number_limit_reached` (the plan's quota is full; with `limit`, `used` and `pending_device_ids`) or `connect_not_allowed`. Without an active plan, `403` without `error`.

409.description: `pending_number_exists` (the account already has a QR number not connected yet, in `device_id`: connect or delete it first) or `operation_in_progress`.

422.description: `invalid_request` (with `errors`), `invalid_reference_device`, `qr_requires_coexistence` (`same_number_as` is an official number not in coexistence), `method_already_present` (with `device_id`), `number_suspended_by_plan`, `idempotency_key_mismatch` or `invalid_idempotency_key`.

get.summary: Get the QR of a number
get.description:
Starts the number's WhatsApp session if needed and answers its QR to scan. Ask again after `expires_in` seconds, until `connected` is `true` (or wait for `device.connected`). Only QR numbers: an official number answers `422 provider_unsupported`. It needs `accounts:operate` because scanning the QR gives control of a WhatsApp.

**Pending of the spec** (contract 1022-alta-de-numeros, not in production yet).

422.description: `provider_unsupported`: the number is not a QR number.

post.description:
A single-use page where your customer connects a number, with no Funnelchat session: `type: "qr"` shows the QR and renews it; `type: "meta"` runs Meta's Embedded Signup. The number is created when the page ends (or the existing one is reconnected, with `device_id`). The quota is checked now and again at the end: the link does not hold a place. Learn the result by `device.connected` (with `connect_link_id` and `external_reference`), by `return_url`, or by reading the link. The raw token is only in `url` of this answer.

At most 20 open links per account (`429 too_many_open_links`), and a per-minute limit. With `type: "meta"` while the official signup is off, `503 meta_connect_disabled`. The page claims the link when your customer presses its button, not when it opens, so a messenger's preview does not burn it. `Idempotency-Key` works as in `POST /api/v1/devices`.

**Pending of the spec** (contract 1022-alta-de-numeros, not in production yet).

403.description: The quota refusals of `POST /api/v1/devices` (not for a reconnect).

422.description: `invalid_request` (with `errors`), `invalid_reference_device`, `connection_type_mismatch` (`device_id` is a number of the other method), `qr_requires_coexistence`, `method_already_present` (with `device_id`), `idempotency_key_mismatch` or `invalid_idempotency_key`.

429.description: `too_many_open_links` (20 open links per account), or the per-minute limit (10 links; `Too Many Attempts.` without `error`).

503.description: `meta_connect_disabled`: the official signup by link is off.
